editorial.blurb: Boqueria Fulton Market delivers an authentic Spanish dining experience with impeccable tapas, perfectly executed paella, and staff that transforms a meal into something genuinely special.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the chef-driven full "boqueria experience" menu rather than restaurant week—and don't miss the paella de mariscos, which reviewers called an 'extreme highlight' with perfectly cooked seafood and ideal rice texture.
